JWT Decode / JWT Verify (HS256) on a token minted in Python.

Run `python tool_check.py`. In CyberChef use AES Decrypt: Key = printed hex, IV = printed hex, Mode GCM, Input = printed ciphertext (hex), GCM Tag = printed tag, Additional Authenticated Data = orders-kek:v1. Then change the AAD to orders-kek:v2.
Run `python tool_check.py`. In CyberChef, build Input = the printed first line repeated 20 times (each line ends with a newline) and run SHA2 (Size 256).

Run `python tool_check.py`. In CyberChef AES Decrypt: Key, IV, GCM Tag and Additional Authenticated Data (hex) as printed, Mode GCM, Input = ct (hex). Then paste only the first 8 tag bytes (the printed truncated tag).
Run `python tool_check.py` and paste the printed base64 string into CyberChef From Base64.

simulation.name: FMPy (GUI + CLI)
